title: DAFB_Wrestling_Mats
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR MOBILITY COMMAND.FA4497  436 CONS LGC
detail_text: 436 th Contracting Squadron is seeking information concerning the availability of small business concern contractors capable of providing the following commodity: Description of Commodity- The 436th Security Forces Squadron (436 SFS) requires new wrestling mats. The salient characteristics for the wrestlings mats shall be: Wrestling mat Total Size: 45’ x 54’ x 1 7/8” 9 Mats 45’ x 6’ x 1 7/8” Color: Black Flexi-Connect mat RAVEN logo centered: 214.5in x 214.5in Contractor shall be able to custom print RAVEN logo on the mats. Please see Attachment 1- Salient Characteristics (Draft) for the RAVEN logo. Work shall comply with all applicable commercial and US military standards/specifications as well as Federal, State, and local laws and regulations. Please see the Attachemtn 1 - Salient Characteristics (Draft) for the description of the required commodity. Please provide current business size standard (e.g. Large or Small Business), Small business socioeconomic status (if applicable), and applicable NAICS codes.
